purpose: Stores a picture and its smaller copies in a vault step by step, so a retry never uploads a finished step twice, and finds the right stored copy of each picture to show.
namedChanges: 0.1.6. new, additive: `loadCopyMap`, `copiesOf`, `thumbUriOf`, `largestUriOf`, `copiesToEnd` (src/copyMap.ts) and `storePictureSet` with its link retry that resumes from the progress (src/storeSet.ts); the types `CopyMap` and `StoredPicture`; no new peer
0.1.5. README only (and one test): the ready signed `send` for the file calls is `signedSend()` in lws-session-bridge 0.1.2, kept out of this unit so it takes no new peer
0.1.4. endFile sends the DELETE to the entity URI's own origin and throws (no request) when the origin given names another host; VaultFile.transcodedFrom may be null and is kept from the listing
0.1.3. new src/files.ts: listVaultFiles, thumbIndexFor, thumbFor, endFile, endPictureFiles, PictureFilesError (host passes origin and a signed send; no new dependency)
0.1.2. a failed link to the full copy still only warns, and the progress carries linkFailures (which full or thumb, and the message), empty when every link landed

0.1.1. peerDependencies picture-upload is "^0.1.0 || ^0.2.0" (main holds 0.2.0; "^0.1.0" stopped npm install with ERESOLVE); src/peerRanges.test.ts checks every @kaigilb peer range against the sibling unit's version; README only otherwise (record shapes, link body, warnings, listing)
C1. baseName falls back to picture, not plant (both places)

C2. uploadWithThumb(master, thumb, sink, target): uploadPicture(x, name) becomes uploadPicture(x, name, target); patchRecord from lws-records, entityIdTail from photo-ref; uploadWithThumb, UploadProgress and ProgressSink are exported
C3. the file extension follows the blob: ext(b) is .webp for image/webp, else .jpg, for the master and the 320 copy

C4. optional full copy as the ROOT (t:TranscodedFrom, Agent.Concept): uploadWithThumb(..., target, full?) uploads master, full, thumb, links the thumb and then the master to the full copy; UploadProgress gains fullEntity, masterLinked, thumbRelinked; linkFullLater(progress, full, sink, target, name?) for a full copy that arrives later; best effort, the master is still answered
C5. buildCopyMap (id tail -> copies by bytes, both link shapes, at most two steps to the root, a broken link in no group) and pickBySize are new; buildThumbMap is verbatim

library.title: Picture sizes upload and copy map (a picture's copies in a vault: list, thumbnail, largest, store, end)
library.note: Picture copies in a vault: remembers what was uploaded and linked, with resume and a retry of the small copy's link (storePictureSet), loads the vault's copy map once (loadCopyMap, copiesOf, thumbUriOf, largestUriOf), lists a vault's files and ends a file or a picture's copies (copiesToEnd); the upload itself is picture-upload, the shrinking picture-shrink, the retry save-queue. It does not link a picture to a record.
